VISIBILITY public

      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper/Lower 1":

          walking 5 minutes
          shoulder_stability 5 minutes

          bent_over_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          tricep_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 15 minutes at conversational to moderate pace
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Tuesday fasted HIIT 20 minutes "Fasted HIIT A":
        warmup:
          mobility 5 minutes
        main:
          6 rounds:
            20 seconds sprint (bike or treadmill) rpe 9
            40 seconds rest
        cooldown:
          light walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Push/Pull Stability":
        warmup:
          light cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          brisk walk 10 minutes
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          neck_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower/Glute Focus":

          bike 5 minutes
          hip mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cardio:
          rowing 12 minutes at steady pace
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper/Lower 2":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
          scapular_retraction 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_dip 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          incline treadmill walk/jog intervals 10 minutes (1 min jog, 2 min walk, repeat)
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          overhead_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Push/Pull Stability":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 12 minutes at moderate pace
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          chin_tuck 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower/Glute Focus":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
          hip_circles 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cardio:
          rower 10 minutes at steady pace
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper/Lower 1 Deload":
        warmup:
          row 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 120 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Push/Pull Stability Deload":
        warmup:
          march_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower/Glute Deload":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):

      DAY Monday training 60m "Intense Hypertrophy Upper/Lower 1":

          cycling 5 minutes

          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          light row 8 minutes

    WEEK 3:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Push/Pull Stability/Technique":
        warmup:
          row 5 minutes

    WEEK 3:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower/Glute Stability/Technique":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:

          hamstring_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          walking 6 minutes cool-down jog
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 60 seconds

HOT YOGA & CARDIO SCHEDULE
  GOALS
    - Maintain aerobic base
    - Improve flexibility and mobility with hot yoga
  SCHEDULE
    - Hot yoga: 2 sessions per week on non-consecutive days, 60 minutes
  NOTES
    - Hydration pre/during/post yoga; monitor heat tolerance
    - If heat intolerance rises, swap session to cooler activity
  ADDITIONS
    - Cardio on lifting days remains moderate; hot yoga adds flexibility and light cardio stimulus
  HIIT_SPEC
    - Fasted morning HIIT: 1–2 sessions in Phase 1; adjust in Phase 2 based on tolerance

NUTRITION PLAN
  GOALS
    - Bone health, perimenopausal symptom support
    - Daily protein target to preserve lean mass
    - Adequate calcium, vitamin D, magnesium, omega-3s
    - Hydration strategy for thermoregulation

  MACRO TARGETS
    - Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day
    - Carbohydrates: moderate
    - Fats: essential fatty acids balanced to calories

  MICRONUTRIENTS & FOOD STRATEGY
    - Calcium: 1,200 mg/day
    - Vitamin D: 800–2,000 IU/day
    - Magnesium: 320–420 mg/day
    - Omega-3s: 1–2 g/day EPA+DHA
    - Vitamin K2: 90–120 mcg/day
  NUTRITION SCHEDULE
    - Breakfast, Lunch, Snack, Dinner, Evening: protein-forward with calcium/Vitamin D sources
  NUANCE & HYDRATION
    - 2.5–3.5 L/day
    - Cooling-friendly meals
  SYNC
    - Pre- and post-workout nutrition: 20–40 g protein + carbs
    - Pre-workout hydration: 250–500 ml; during warm-up 150–250 ml if needed
  SAFETY NOTES
    - GP guidance for supplements
  IMPLEMENTATION NOTES
    - Phase-aligned, flexible; recalibrate Phase 2 as needed

FASTED HIIT SAFETY & INTEGRATION
  - 1–2 sessions Phase 1; adjust Phase 2 by tolerance
  - Hydration and post-session recovery

1RM TESTING
  GOALS
    - End of Phase 3: assess 1RM for bench_press, squat (or leg press proxy), deadlift
  TIMING
    - Schedule tests after Phase 3 with sufficient recovery
  TEST PROTOCOL
    - 3–5 attempts per lift; rest 3–5 minutes
  SAFETY
    - GP clearance, monitor symptoms
  DATA RECORDING
    - Record 1RM for future programming

PHASE 3 & BEYOND
  - Phase 3: 4 weeks focusing on peak strength and recovery; follow with 1RM testing at end
  - Phase 4: calibration based on 1RM outcomes, potential rebuild or maintenance plan

CALENDAR NOTES
  - Start date: 2026-06-01
  - Weeks align to Monday start; adjust calendar if needed
  - Phase transitions defined to progress intensity and include hot yoga & HIIT windows

DATA OUTPUT
  - All exercises use canonical vocab
  - Rep ranges use two dots (e.g., 4x8..12)
  - RPE, rest, and tempo follow format described
  - Cardio modalities limited to approved list
  - Nutrition and cardio sections integrated with training plan
